styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and info panels, warm amber #F2A93B for hero and CTA panels, deep night blue #1E3E9C for the quiet-night panel, light wood-plank floor #D9B98A for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; night panels use dim cool rim light
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light wood-plank floor #D9B98A and matte neutral boards #E9E4DC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D or white #FFFFFF, headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: flat circle line icons and rounded rectangular labels in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: upright vertical tower product, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: consistent warm summer home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm amber #F2A93B, deep night blue #1E3E9C and one vivid orange accent #F08A1D, with charcoal #2D2D2D reserved for body and label text; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D or white #FFFFFF; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and flat circle line icons in the single accent color; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; upright vertical tower product with a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
